target_customer: Consumers with skin concerns (free app); longer term clinicians and skincare brands buying data
problem: People waste money on trial and error in skincare because advice is vague and biased and there is no record of what works for similar skin.
business_model: Freemium consumer app with a paid Premium tier; planned data platform for brands and clinicians
product_category: Consumer skincare tracking and community app

founders.name: Ahana Banerjee
founders.background_notes: Describes years of cystic acne as the origin; Forbes 30 Under 30 per company pages.

founders.name: Ben Richards
founders.background_notes: Named with Banerjee in Imperial's June 2021 news item; later pages list only Banerjee.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile app with logging, photos and a product database; later AI and data layer is harder but was not the 2021 product.

defensibility.rationale: A longitudinal dataset of routines and outcomes could compound, but it starts empty and trackers are easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found; the founders told Imperial it was first of its kind.

market_need_then: The launch post says people spend heavily on skincare without knowing what works and that advice is not designed for people of colour. No spend data was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Transparency stated as a priority by the founder

branding.brand_signature: Compares routines with people of similar skin tone and concern
branding.community_and_virality: Frames itself as a Strava-like sharing community; featured by Apple (App of the Day) and a L'Oreal Beauty Tech for Good award per company pages.

brand_strength.rationale: Some press and awards, but a generic name shared with many products and limited coverage.

outcome_analysis: Clear remains active as a small team. It got press from Imperial in June 2021, joined YC W21, later added a paid Premium tier, and says it has 70,000 documented experiences. Funding amounts are not confirmed by any primary source, so its trajectory in terms of rounds is unknown rather than weak.
notes: Funding unverified: BounceWatch and VCBacked report 840K pre-seed in 2021-12 (YC, Pioneer Fund, Amino Capital, Mora Financial); CB Insights lists 130K seed on 2021-08-31. All aggregators, so no round is recorded. YC page says Demo Day facilitated funding without figures. Competitors: neither the YC launch post, Imperial article nor company site names any, and a dated search found only current app-store listings, so the list is left empty. Haut Technologies Inc operates the app. Update: each recorded round rests on a single database (Bouncewatch for 840K in 2021-12; CB Insights for 130K in 2021-08-31) and they may overlap. The founder's own forum post claims about 1M VC raised at a 15M valuation, a gap not itemized.
